10k.note: 10-K describes Illumina as a sequencing instruments / consumables / informatics provider. No proprietary therapeutic pipeline.

website.error: Illumina is a genomics tools and clinical diagnostics vendor; no therapeutic-drug pipeline page exists. Product portfolio (NovaSeq, NextSeq, MiSeq, TruSight oncology assays) is commercial.

ctgov.note: All ctgov hits map to Innervate Radiopharmaceuticals LLC (formerly Illumina Radiopharmaceuticals LLC), an unrelated private entity, not Illumina, Inc. (ILMN). Excluded as not the issuer.

commercial_product.note: Illumina sells sequencing instruments (NovaSeq X / 6000, NextSeq, MiSeq, iSeq), consumables and informatics, plus IVD/clinical assays such as TruSight Oncology Comprehensive (TSO Comp, EU IVDR) and TruSight Oncology 500. These are commercial diagnostic products, not active drug-pipeline assets.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Lead sponsor Innervate Radiopharmaceuticals (formerly Illumina Radiopharmaceuticals LLC) — unrelated entity, not Illumina, Inc.
Same — Innervate Radiopharmaceuticals, not the issuer.
